gospel.text:
[[Mc 9,38]]John said to Jesus, "Teacher, we saw someone driving out demons in your name, and we tried to prevent him because he does not follow us."
[[Mc 9,39]]Jesus replied, "Do not prevent him. There is no one who performs a mighty deed in my name who can at the same time speak ill of me.
[[Mc 9,40]]For whoever is not against us is for us.
gospel.title: Holy Gospel of Jesus Christ according to Saint Mark

psalm.title: Psalms
psalm.text:
[[Ps 119,165]]Those who love your law have great peace, 
And for them there is no stumbling block.
[[Ps 119,168]]I keep your precepts and your decrees, 
For all my ways are before you.

[[Ps 119,171]]My lips pour forth your praise, 
because you teach me your statutes.
[[Ps 119,172]]May my tongue sing of your promise, 
for all your commands are just.

[[Ps 119,174]]I long for your salvation, O LORD, 
and your law is my delight.
[[Ps 119,175]]Let my soul live to praise you, 
and may your ordinances help me.

first_reading.title: Book of Sirach
first_reading.text:
[[Si 4,12]]He who loves her loves life; those who seek her out win her favor.
[[Si 4,13]]He who holds her fast inherits glory; wherever he dwells, the LORD bestows blessings.
[[Si 4,14]]Those who serve her serve the Holy One; those who love her the LORD loves.
[[Si 4,15]]He who obeys her judges nations; he who hearkens to her dwells in her inmost chambers.
[[Si 4,16]]If one trusts her, he will possess her; his descendants too will inherit her.
[[Si 4,17]]She walks with him as a stranger, and at first she puts him to the test; Fear and dread she brings upon him and tries him with her discipline; With her precepts she puts him to the proof, until his heart is fully with her.
[[Si 4,18]]Then she comes back to bring him happiness and reveal her secrets to him.
[[Si 4,19]]But if he fails her, she will abandon him and deliver him into the hands of despoilers.
[[Si 4,20]]Use your time well; guard yourself from evil, and bring upon yourself no shame.
[[Si 4,21]]There is a sense of shame laden with guilt, and a shame that merits honor and respect.
[[Si 4,22]]Show no favoritism to your own discredit; let no one intimidate you to your own downfall.
